summary.text: The qi harvest fruit is a qi path immortal material, the essence of qi path and the fusion of the five regions' qi. Placing it into an immortal aperture turns it into turbulent qi flows that hasten the transformation of heaven and earth qi.

claims.text: Wu Yong browses an information path mortal Gu listing qi path immortal materials that appeared from the qi tides. He asks Wu Ba Chong whether the qi harvest fruit really has such great effects. Wu Ba Chong says many Gu Immortals have already used it, and that whoever can get more qi harvest fruits will get through this period of inactivity more quickly. Wu Yong orders him to collect more of this immortal material.

After the qi tides appeared, people often found qi harvest fruits produced. Used in an immortal aperture, they can rapidly soothe heaven and earth qi and hasten the progress of heaven and earth qi fusion. Ordinary qi harvest fruits are as large as a horse carriage.

In Ice Crystal grotto-heaven, the immortals find a fruit the size of a hill, translucent, formed from heaven and earth qi, and shaped like a gourd or a peanut. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch finds it still growing, absorbing the grotto-heaven’s heaven and earth qi. Taking it away would cause a huge commotion, living beings would die, and a more turbulent qi tide would appear. Pulling it out by force would harm the grotto-heaven’s foundation. Directly destroying it would create a new qi tide, which would produce a second qi harvest fruit.

Fang Yuan knows from his previous life that qi harvest fruits appeared in the two heavens’ grotto-heaven headquarters, used those grotto-heavens’ heaven and earth qi to grow, and would destroy the entire grotto-heaven world if left unattended. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch’s fight against Heavenly Court caused qi tides in his grotto-heaven, so the fruits appeared earlier than in that previous life.

Luo clan’s three Gu Immortals reach the center of Qi Jue grotto-heaven and see a tiny exquisite qi harvest fruit with flowing lights on its surface. It is the size of a gourd and holds a genuine rank nine immortal material aura, with surging vitality. They know qi harvest fruits are produced by the qi tides. They find it strange that this one would be hidden by Demon Immortal Qi Jue and kept here, and they ask why.

At the eye of the storm where countless qi currents merge, a tiny and delicate qi harvest fruit absorbs surrounding qi currents of all types and assimilates their traits. A human baby is curled up inside, growing larger by the second. The fruit is like a woman’s womb. When Wu Shuai tries to use dreamy light smoke, the fruit seems to sense it, shakes, and self-detonates. A baby is born. The boy names himself Demon Immortal Qi Jue.
